messages:
nina: Quick heads-up: Stream Gateway GA is live in prod. This consolidates streaming + tool-calls to POST /v1/stream-gateway. Docs + migration notes: https://redwood.internal/docs/stream-gateway-ga. Please review if you own SDKs, onboarding guides, or customer comms.

tom: Nice! Any perf numbers from canary?

nina: Canary looked good: median p95 latency down 12% vs old stack, throughput up ~18% with default batching. We did see a small class of transient 503s early on.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: rollout summary: stream-gateway deployed across 4 regions. Canary progression: 10% -> 100%. Detected transient 503 spike at 2026-04-09T03:22Z on 2/12 replicas; automated retries mitigated client impact.

oliver: Root cause?

nina: Short version: CUDA driver mismatch on one machine image caused a tokenization subprocess to crash under load. Fixed by reverting that image and increasing container restart backoff. Full incident notes in Confluence.

maya: Any customer-facing changes? Will this require SDK updates?

nina: Minimal API shape change: single envelope now accepts {"model","stream","tools","input"}. Backwards compatibility for 14 days. We pushed SDK patches that add a gateway helper; maintainers should cut releases today.

tom: Billing or telemetry updates?

nina: Token billing unchanged. Policy update: default telemetry sampling for new orgs is 1%; existing orgs unchanged unless they opt in. Console shows per-route cost delta if you switch.

oliver: Ops note: if you need higher-rate canary keys DM me. Also updated alerts: gateway-p95 and gateway-error-rate, and added a dashboard for model-fallbacks.

nina: TL;DR: Stream Gateway GA live, small transient canary incident resolved, SDK patches published, 14-day opt-in for existing orgs, canary keys via @oliver, docs + runbook at internal link. Ping me for help. :tada:
